title: Strawberry Crunch Ice Cream Sandwiches
hookLine: Soft chocolate wafer or cookie rounds stuffed with no-churn strawberry cheesecake ice cream.

items.name: Soft chocolate chip or Oreo cookies
Strawberry or vanilla bean ice cream

steps.title: Line Freezer Tray & Prep Mix-Ins
steps.instructionTemplate: Line a rimmed baking sheet or loaf pan with parchment paper so your frozen treat lifts out cleanly. Measure out {cookies_is} and {ice_is} and keep toppings like {crunch_is} prepped within reach.

steps.title: Sandwich Ice Cream & Roll in Crunch
steps.instructionTemplate: Scoop softened {ice_is} between pairs of {cookies_is}, roll exposed edges in {crunch_is}, and freeze 45 mins to set firm. Chill or freeze until completely firm and set, then portion into 6 servings and store leftovers in an airtight container.
steps.creatorSecret: Pre-chill your serving bowls or glasses in the freezer for 10 minutes for instant cafe presentation.

steps.title: Transfer, Smooth Top & Add Garnish
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour or press the mixture evenly into your prepared dish, smoothing the surface with a spatula. Scatter {crunch_is} evenly across the top and press gently so it adheres cleanly.

steps.title: Freeze Solid, Portion & Enjoy
steps.instructionTemplate: Freeze Strawberry Crunch Ice Cream Sandwiches flat until completely solid, then let sit 3 minutes at room temperature before slicing, snapping, or scooping into 6 servings. Store leftovers in a freezer-safe container.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 12 mins.
